rows.reply: Thank you for contacting us regarding the report of a 7-year-old child in Bekasi who is allegedly being confined without food. Your report has been registered under ticket number ATK-01 and has been escalated to our Special Protection team, who will provide an initial response within 2 hours. A supervisor has been alerted to this matter immediately. If the child is in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110, or SAPA 129 via phone at 129 or WhatsApp at 08111-129-129 [3]. To assist with our assessment, please prepare your identity, the child's identity, and any supporting information regarding the complaint [2]. Following this, a social worker will assess the case to determine the appropriate referral to a service provider such as the UPTD PPA or the police [1]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai banjir rob di Bedono, Sayung, dengan nomor tiket ATK-02. Laporan ini telah kami teruskan kepada tim penanganan bencana kami dan supervisor telah diberitahu mengenai situasi darurat ini untuk mendapatkan tanggapan dalam waktu 2 jam [1]. Jika Anda atau keluarga berada dalam bahaya langsung, mohon segera hubungi layanan darurat 112, polisi di 110, atau SAPA 129 di nomor 129 atau WhatsApp 08111-129-129. Selanjutnya, petugas kami akan melakukan kunjungan lapangan ke lokasi bencana untuk melakukan penilaian kebutuhan [2]. Mohon tetap tenang dan utamakan keselamatan. Salam, Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi KPAI. Kami memahami kekhawatiran Anda mengenai perundungan yang dialami anak Anda di sekolah di Semarang, dan laporan Anda telah kami terima dengan nomor tiket ATK-03. Laporan ini akan ditangani oleh tim Pendidikan, Seni, Budaya, dan Agama kami dalam waktu 72 jam. Jika anak Anda berada dalam bahaya saat ini, silakan segera hubungi SAPA 129 melalui nomor 129 atau WhatsApp 08111-129-129, atau hubungi polisi di nomor 110 [3]. Selanjutnya, seorang pekerja sosial akan melakukan penilaian terhadap laporan Anda untuk menentukan langkah perlindungan yang tepat [1]. Mohon siapkan dokumen identitas Anda, identitas anak (seperti akta kelahiran atau kartu keluarga), serta informasi pendukung lainnya terkait kejadian tersebut [2]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Thank you for reaching out to KPAI regarding the cyberbullying your 14-year-old son is experiencing on Instagram. Your report has been registered under ticket number ATK-04 and has been forwarded to our Special Protection team for review. An officer will contact you within 72 hours to follow up on your report [1]. To proceed with your complaint, please prepare your identity, the child's identity such as a birth certificate or family card, and any information supporting the complaint. If you or your child are in immediate danger, please contact SAPA 129 at 129 or via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129, or call the police at 110. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi kami. Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai bantuan PKH yang belum cair selama tiga bulan dengan nomor tiket ATK-05. Laporan Anda saat ini telah diteruskan ke Bidang Perlindungan dan Jaminan Sosial untuk ditindaklanjuti dalam waktu 72 jam [1]. Petugas kami akan memeriksa status penerima di DTSEN, status penyaluran tahap berjalan, serta status kartu KKS atau rekening Anda [3]. Jika Anda membutuhkan bantuan lebih lanjut terkait perlindungan perempuan dan anak, Anda dapat menghubungi SAPA 129 melalui nomor 129 atau WhatsApp 08111-129-129. Salam hangat, Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

Thank you for contacting us regarding your BPNT aid status in Karangtengah. Your inquiry has been assigned ticket number ATK-06 and is being handled by our Social Protection and Security Division. We will provide an initial response within 72 hours. Please note that we cannot provide written guarantees regarding payment dates, as we must first verify your recipient status in DTSEN, your current payment status, and your KKS card or bank account details [1]. To assist us, could you please provide your full name and your KKS card number? Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

Thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI). We have received your request regarding the contact information of an officer in Depok and your request to close your case, which has been assigned ticket number ATK-07. Our Complaints Unit is currently reviewing your inquiry and will provide an initial response within 336 hours. Please note that we cannot disclose the personal contact details of our officers. Regarding your request to close a case, this process requires an agreement between the complainant and KPAI [2]. To help us assist you further, could you please provide your full name and the specific case reference number you are referring to? If you are in an emergency situation, please contact SAPA 129 (women and child protection hotline) at 129 or via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129, or call the police emergency number at 110. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi KPAI. Kami telah menerima pesan Anda dengan nomor tiket ATK-08, namun pesan tersebut tidak berisi laporan terkait perlindungan anak. Tim kami akan meninjau laporan Anda dan memberikan tanggapan dalam waktu 336 jam. Mohon informasikan kepada kami apakah Anda memiliki laporan spesifik terkait pelanggaran hak anak, dan mohon sertakan identitas pelapor serta identitas anak yang bersangkutan jika ada. Jika Anda membutuhkan bantuan darurat terkait perlindungan anak, silakan hubungi SAPA 129 melalui nomor 129 atau WhatsApp 08111-129-129. Salam, Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Thank you for contacting us regarding your concern about the increase in food prices at your child's school canteen. Your report has been registered under ticket number ATK-09 and is currently being handled by our Education, leisure, culture and religion team. You can expect a response from us within 336 hours. As a next step, a social worker will assess your complaint to determine the appropriate support or referral [1]. To assist with this process, please prepare your identity documents, the child's identity such as a birth certificate or family card, and any information supporting your complaint [2]. If you require immediate assistance, you may contact SAPA 129 at 129 or via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

We have received your report regarding the lack of clean water in Bedono village following the tidal flood, and your ticket number is ATK-10. This matter has been assigned to our Disaster Protection team, and you can expect a response within 2 hours [1]. A supervisor has been alerted to your situation immediately. If anyone is in immediate danger, please contact the general emergency services at 112 or the BPBD Demak for disaster management assistance. Our team will now proceed with a site visit to identify the necessary aid requirements. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)

Terima kasih atas laporan Anda mengenai dugaan eksploitasi dan kekerasan terhadap anak di Simpang Lima, yang telah kami catat dengan nomor tiket ATK-11. Laporan Anda telah diteruskan kepada tim Perlindungan Khusus (trafficking, eksploitasi, pornografi, dan kejahatan siber) dan seorang supervisor telah diberitahu mengenai kondisi mendesak ini. Jika anak tersebut berada dalam bahaya saat ini, mohon segera hubungi SAPA 129 melalui nomor 129 atau WhatsApp 08111-129-129, atau hubungi polisi di nomor 110 [3]. Selanjutnya, laporan Anda akan melalui tahap penilaian oleh pekerja sosial untuk menentukan langkah perlindungan atau rujukan ke penyedia layanan seperti UPTD PPA atau kepolisian [1]. Untuk melengkapi proses ini, mohon siapkan identitas pelapor, identitas anak, serta informasi pendukung lainnya terkait kejadian tersebut [2]. Kami akan memberikan tanggapan dalam waktu 2 jam. Salam, Unit Pengaduan, Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia (KPAI).

Thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI) regarding your inquiry, which has been assigned ticket number ATK-12. Please be informed that we cannot share the personal information of other complainants due to our data privacy and confidentiality policies. Your request is currently being handled by our Complaints unit and you can expect a response within 336 hours. To ensure we can assist you with your specific case, please confirm if you have already submitted your identity, the child's identity, and supporting information about the complaint [1]. If you have not yet provided these, please send them to us so we can proceed with registering your complaint [1]. For urgent assistance, you may contact SAPA 129 (women and child protection hotline) at 129 or via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi kami. Kami memahami kekhawatiran Anda mengenai status KIS lansia ibu Anda yang tidak aktif, dan laporan Anda telah kami catat dengan nomor tiket ATK-13. Tim SLRT kami akan menindaklanjuti laporan ini dalam waktu 72 jam. Untuk membantu proses verifikasi, mohon informasikan NIK ibu Anda dan apakah beliau masih terdaftar dalam Kartu Keluarga yang sama. Sesuai prosedur, tim kami akan melakukan pencatatan data dan pemeriksaan administrasi untuk menentukan langkah selanjutnya [1], [2]. Mohon siapkan salinan KTP dan Kartu Keluarga (KK) untuk keperluan verifikasi lebih lanjut [1], [2]. Jika Anda membutuhkan bantuan darurat, Anda dapat menghubungi layanan darurat 112. Salam hangat, Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

We have received your report regarding the alleged inappropriate physical contact by a teacher toward your niece, which has been assigned ticket number ATK-14. This matter has been escalated to our Special Protection team, who will review your case within 2 hours. A supervisor has been alerted to this report immediately. If the child is in immediate danger, please contact SAPA 129 (WhatsApp 08111-129-129), the police emergency line at 110, or the general emergency line at 112. Following this, a social worker will assess the complaint to determine the necessary psychoeducation or referral to a service provider [1]. To proceed, please prepare the complainant's identity, the child's identity, and any supporting information regarding the incident [2]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).
